firstPlayerRule: The person who did a good deed most recently starts building.
officialTieBreak: If the players cannot agree, the youngest player starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This is the base game's instruction; Rhino Hero: Super Battle uses a different criterion.
